verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents first-party webhooks: when you subscribe to price tracking for a product, it sends webhook notifications whenever the price changes. That is a real outbound HTTP callback, but the pack shows only this one event type and gives no details on how webhooks are registered or delivered. Missing for 10: webhook events beyond price changes, documented endpoint registration, payload schema, signing/verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
